jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer, Runtime
jobs.description: About Our Client: The organization operates in the enterprise software industry, focusing on enabling companies to build, run, and evolve complex, mission-critical applications without producing unvetted or unsecured code. It addresses the challenge of managing AI usage across the software development lifecycle, helping enterprises accelerate digital transformation while reducing risk and total cost of ownership. About the Opportunity: The SENIOR QA ENGINEER, RUNTIME is responsible for ensuring the quality and security of the core runtime engine that powers all applications on the platform. This role leads test automation efforts to maintain a fast, stable, and secure runtime environment, influencing release readiness and overall product reliability. The position contributes by building trusted automated test suites, improving security testing, and using AI tools to scale coverage, thereby directly impacting the organization's ability to deliver high-quality software efficiently. Responsibilities: Design, write, and maintain Playwright test suites covering critical runtime flows. Review and enforce high standards for automation code quality. Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines as release quality gates. Participate early in feature development to define testability requirements. Develop security checks and collaborate with security teams to address findings. Create and maintain performance and load tests for runtime components. Utilize AI tools to enhance test scaffolding, triage, and regression coverage. Migrate legacy tests to modern frameworks and retire obsolete ones. Reproduce and document customer-reported bugs, converting them into automated tests. Conduct exploratory testing to identify issues beyond automation coverage. Requirements: Minimum 5 years in Quality or Software Engineering, with at least 3 years focused on test automation. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript. Hands-on experience with Playwright for end-to-end testing. Proven ability to build or stabilize regression test suites with measurable results. Experience reviewing test code and setting team automation standards. Solid understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, DOM, HTTP, REST APIs, and browser DevTools. Knowledge of web application security testing principles and practices. Experience with performance/load testing tools such as k6. Skilled in using AI coding tools and critically assessing their output. Ability to work independently and communicate risks effectively. Preferred: Experience with API contract testing, visual regression testing, and low-code/codeless platforms. Pay Range and Compensation Package: Tier 1: $109,600 - $137,000 Tier 2: $100,000 - $125,000 Compensation includes base salary, potential incentives, and company equity. Pay is determined by factors including location, experience, skills, and market data. Benefits & Perks: Remote-first work environment Unlimited PTO with encouragement to use it Student loan repayment program
